claims.claim: Permutation language modeling permutes factorization order without reordering natural token positions.
claims.verification_note: Distinguishes attention prediction order from physical text order.

claims.claim: Two-stream self-attention separates target-position query representation from target-containing content representation to avoid leakage.
claims.verification_note: Query stream cannot attend to its own current token content; content stream can.

claims.claim: XLNet introduces partial prediction, optimizing a subset of prediction factors.
claims.verification_note: Full permutation log-likelihood is conceptual objective, practical training uses partial prediction.

claims.claim: XLNet integrates Transformer-XL recurrence and relative position encoding.
claims.verification_note: Distinguishes architecture change from PLM objective change.

claims.claim: The implementation exposes permutation attention masks and target mappings.
claims.locator: XLNetModel forward arguments perm_mask and target_mapping
claims.verification_note: Implementation interface is not presented as exact original paper pseudocode.

claims.claim: The toy four-token permutation does not imply every target sees all natural left/right context in one forward pass.
claims.verification_note: Expected over factorization orders; each prediction conditions only on earlier permutation positions.
